# Jot Local 0.5.1
- Fixed a crash during microphone preparation when the input device or audio format changes. - Failed microphone setup now returns a recoverable error instead of closing Jot. - Discarded stale prepared audio engines after microphone changes. - Closing the last window explicitly keeps Jot running in the menu bar.

Customize S1-mini's local cleanup style in Settings → Dictation.
- Choose a writing style: Casual, Semi-casual, Semi-formal, or Formal. - Expand Advanced controls to choose prose or lists and general or email context. - Choices are saved and apply to the next cleanup without reloading the models. - Turn Smart cleanup off to insert the literal transcript; style controls are disabled while it is off. - A visible Check for Updates button is now available in About. - The Privacy link opens Jot Local's current privacy documentation, including optional update checks and downloads.
Updates are signed and notarized, ask before restarting, and wait for active dictation work. Requires macOS 14 or later and Apple Silicon.

Jot Local now checks for signed updates and downloads them automatically.
- Use Check for Updates from the menu bar to check immediately. - Automatic checks and downloads can be switched off in the menu bar. - Updates ask before restarting and wait for active dictation work to finish. - Downloaded updates can also install when you quit normally. - Dictation, transcripts, settings, and local models remain on your Mac.
Requires macOS 14 or later and Apple Silicon. Install this first updater-enabled version manually; future versions can update in the app.
